assessment_summary: The proof is completely valid and mathematically robust. It elegantly uses the properties of elements of order 7 and their orbits to show that no graph on 8 to 13 vertices can have an automorphism group exactly equal to PSL(2,7). Minor typographical errors (such as writing S_7 instead of A_7 for the overgroup of two 7-cycles, or writing A \cup B instead of A \cap B when referring to the parts of A) do not affect the logical validity of the deductions. The logic holds perfectly.
